roles.introBefore: The 5 permission levels that exist in ATHLOS (
roles.introAfter: in the database) and what each one can do. How many users in your organization have each role assigned today — see the full detail in the Users tab.

definition.admin: Full access. The only role that can manage Users and edit the Organization in Settings, and the only one that can delete protected rows (injuries, GPS sessions, videos, league stats rows).
definition.coach: Can create and edit operational data (roster, wellness, videos, GPS loads, league stats), but cannot manage users, edit the Organization, or delete the rows protected for admins.
definition.medical: Same data-writing permissions as coach — intended for medical staff.
definition.analyst: Same data-writing permissions as coach — intended for analytics staff.
definition.viewer: Read-only role. Not on the list of roles with write permission — the database rejects any attempt to create, edit, or delete data, though some screens don't visually block it beforehand (see Permission matrix).

tooltip.enforcedAdminLocked: An admin can always do this — it prevents the org from being left with no one who can.

legend.navigation: the checkbox controls in real time which menu modules each role sees and blocks direct access by URL.
legend.rest: most checkboxes already change real behavior (RLS or backend) — they're marked with their own note under "how it's gated". The few rows that are still only target configuration say so explicitly (own profile, invite/change role/delete user).
legend.adminColumn: stays locked on connected rows, so no admin can leave their own organization with no one able to perform that action.
